# Fred's Plumbing

> Fred's Plumbing is a commercial and multi-family plumbing company serving
> the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex since 1996. Licensed by the State of Texas
> (RMP 44890) and fully insured, it provides 24/7 emergency response,
> preventive maintenance programs, drain and sewer service, water heater
> work, backflow testing, and code-compliant installations for apartment
> communities, condominiums, assisted living, nursing homes, student
> housing, and commercial buildings.

Phone: 972-564-9081 (answered 24/7)
Email: service@fredsplumbingdfw.com
Service area: Dallas, Fort Worth, Arlington, Irving, Plano, Frisco,
Grapevine, Grand Prairie, McKinney, Richardson, and surrounding North Texas
communities.

## Services

- [Plumbing Services](https://www.fredsplumbingdfw.com/services/plumbing): Repairs, repipes, fixtures, slab leak detection, and installations for commercial and multi-family properties.
- [Emergency Plumbing](https://www.fredsplumbingdfw.com/services/emergency-plumbing): 24/7 rapid response for leaks, backups, and pipe failures.
- [Drain & Sewer](https://www.fredsplumbingdfw.com/services/drain-sewer): Camera inspection, cleaning, repair, and maintenance.
- [Preventive Maintenance](https://www.fredsplumbingdfw.com/services/maintenance): Scheduled programs that reduce downtime and prevent failures.
- [Commercial Plumbing](https://www.fredsplumbingdfw.com/services/commercial-plumbing): Property-wide solutions for offices and facilities.
- [Specialty Services](https://www.fredsplumbingdfw.com/services/specialty-services): Backflow testing, gas lines, and hydro jetting.

## Property types

- [Apartments](https://www.fredsplumbingdfw.com/multifamily/apartments): Unit turns, risers, and property-wide repairs.
- [Condos](https://www.fredsplumbingdfw.com/multifamily/condos): HOA-coordinated work on shared systems.
- [Assisted Living](https://www.fredsplumbingdfw.com/multifamily/assisted-living): Low-disruption service around residents.
- [Nursing Homes](https://www.fredsplumbingdfw.com/multifamily/nursing-homes): Code-compliant work in 24/7 care settings.
